RESIDUAL-GAP DISPOSITION SWEEP (all four children closed; before epic close).
FILED: (1) 8772-d92c-5682-4718 — rebar-owned root span per gate run, so one run is one Langfuse trace and the header id matches the exported spans; deferred from the epic's Out-of-scope and confirmed by its own plan-review as not achieved by the shipped read. (2) b735-788d-72eb-411f — emit openai-chat: instead of bare openai: before pydantic-ai v2.0 flips the default to the Responses API; surfaced by the epic's spike, latent behind the <2 pin.
ACCEPTED: (a) under one coarse caller-owned span, sequential gate runs inherit a single trace id and Langfuse shows them as one trace — stated in 6cd0's plan with the Langfuse trace-vs-session rationale; the root-span ticket is the proper fix. (b) extra_headers is inert on Bedrock at the pinned pydantic-ai (zero refs in models/bedrock.py); the base_url gate already excludes that path and 98b6 documents it.
FIXED IN SCOPE: docs/env-vars.md regeneration declared in file_impact on ee8a and 6cd0; the S1 documentation advisory delivered by sibling 98b6; the unsatisfiable vendor-scan AC narrowed to header-shaped literals and now enforced by test; the four S2 criteria that were unverified at tick time (both schema validations, real-runner :719, deterministic-null) covered before ticking.
SURFACE PARITY: the header surface is configuration-only — CLI (-c llm.headers), env (REBAR_LLM_HEADERS) and file table are all covered and tested; no MCP tool or CLI verb exposes LLM provider config, and LLMConfig is the library facade, so no parallel surface is left unproven.
